verdict.rationale: Bland documents a built-in Knowledge feature for agents. It is described as "how an agent answers from your content rather than from its prompt," reading answers out of the documents you provide, which directly matches the story. However, the evidence is a single first-party doc snippet with little depth. Missing for 10: details on supported document types and ingestion sources, retrieval/RAG configuration or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
